title: Backend Core: SQLite Database, Spotify Guest Auth & Pathfinder Scraper
description: Implement the complete backend data pipeline: SQLite database schema with better-sqlite3, Spotify guest token acquisition, Pathfinder GraphQL artist/track data extraction, rate-limited batch orchestrator, artist registry seeding, and standalone CLI scrape entry point. Also scaffold the Next.js project with package.json, tsconfig, and config files.
acceptance_criteria: package.json declares dependencies: next@15, react@19, react-dom@19, better-sqlite3, recharts, tailwindcss@4, typescript@5, vitest, @types/better-sqlite3
tsconfig.json uses strict mode with paths alias '@/*' -> 'src/*'
src/lib/db/schema.ts creates all 4 tables (artists, artist_snapshots, track_snapshots, scrape_runs) with exact indexes specified in DB_SCHEMA_CONTRACT
src/lib/db/client.ts exports a singleton DB connection using better-sqlite3 with WAL mode enabled
src/lib/scraper/auth.ts acquires Spotify guest tokens via open.spotify.com/get_access_token and caches until expiry
src/lib/scraper/artist.ts extracts artist metadata + monthly listeners from Pathfinder GraphQL
src/lib/scraper/tracks.ts extracts exact track playcounts from Pathfinder GraphQL for an artist's full discography
src/lib/scraper/catalog.ts discovers all albums/singles/EPs and their tracks for an artist
src/lib/scraper/orchestrator.ts implements rate-limited sequential batch processing with randomized jitter (2-5s), retry with exponential backoff, and negative delta guards

src/config/artists.ts exports a registry of 15+ DHH artists (KR$NA, Seedhe Maut, MC Stan, DIVINE, Raftaar, Talha Anjum, Talhah Yunus, Karma, Raga, Bella, etc.) conforming to ArtistRegistryEntry contract
scripts/scrape.ts is a standalone CLI entry point: `npx tsx scripts/scrape.ts` runs a full scrape batch
.github/workflows/daily-scrape.yml runs the scraper daily at 06:00 UTC via GitHub Actions cron
All scraper functions correctly handle 429/5xx with backoff, never crash on network errors
All TypeScript imports from contracts.ts use the readonly branded types
